digest_construction.request_before_injection:
POST /v1/charges HTTP/1.1

{"amount":100}
digest_construction.rule: request_sha256 and params_sha256 cover the request before credential injection, never after

scheme.actor: authority_mode and attestations always; did_key unless the authority is system, which carries no identity; grant_id exactly when the authority is identity_grant; attestations are at most four strict unpadded base64url strings, untyped at this layer, each verified by its consumer under its own contract
scheme.canonical: keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace, strings of printable ASCII (0x20-0x7E) escaping only quote and backslash, integers within +-(2^53-1), no floats and no null; a verifier re-encodes and requires identical bytes
scheme.did_keys: every did:key decodes to an Ed25519 public key
scheme.layers: envelope faults are refused by every envelope verifier; catalog faults pass the envelope layer and are refused by the catalog reader with the stated error and field
scheme.order: the verifier's expected team is required; prefix; strict parse (duplicate keys, floats, null, non-ASCII, nesting deeper than 8); canonical bytes; envelope fields top-down; catalog; hook; trace; team_id; producer; actor; times; result_status; payload shape; producer kind allowed for the hook; a client event's actor is its signer; the expected team; the signature
scheme.producer_kinds: core {origin, kid, did_key, seq}; app {origin, app_id, installation_id, generation, kid, did_key, seq}; client {did_key, certificate_id}, with no seq
scheme.signature: detached Ed25519 by the producer's did:key: exactly 86 characters of the standard base64 alphabet, no padding, zero trailing bits
scheme.signing_bytes: the ASCII prefix 'aweb.hook-event/1' and a newline, then the envelope's canonical JSON
scheme.times: occurred_at and fired_at are UTC with exactly three fractional digits, in their one canonical spelling
